summary: Peltola stated she "stands firmly with Israel and its right to defend" after the October 7 attacks and in May 2024 voted with Republicans to approve arms for Israel, defying her party's position. Her Senate campaign declined in August 2026 to confirm or deny standing by that record. She had voted against a separate November 2023 aid package as one of twelve Democrats, but the pattern of Israel-centric framing and cross-party arms support aligns with shielding Israel.
